features.label: Tempo
features.explain: Beats per minute from the percussive layer.

features.label: Note density
features.explain: Percussive onsets per second; how busy the rhythm is.

features.label: Syncopation
features.explain: Share of onsets that land off the beat.

features.label: Beat regularity
features.explain: 1 minus the variation of beat intervals; 1 is metronomic.

features.label: Tempo stability
features.explain: How little the local tempo moves inside the 10 s window.

features.label: Timing grid lock
features.explain: How close onsets sit to a 16th-note grid. 100 is perfectly on grid.

features.label: Timing deviation
features.explain: Average distance of an onset from the nearest grid point.

features.label: Swing
features.explain: Where the off-beat lands inside the beat. 50 is straight, about 67 is triplet swing.

features.label: Tempo breathing (30 s)
features.explain: Variation of the local tempo curve across the middle 30 s.

features.label: Breathing gaps (30 s)
features.explain: Short silences of 150 ms or more between phrases in the middle 30 s.

features.label: Repeat exactness
features.explain: Highest similarity between two 8 s passages at different times. Near 1 means near-identical repeats.

features.label: Brightness
features.explain: Spectral centroid; where the energy of the sound is centred.

features.label: Spectral width
features.explain: How spread the spectrum is around its centre.

features.label: Noisiness
features.explain: Spectral flatness. Higher is more noise-like, lower is more tonal.

features.label: Melodic vs percussive
features.explain: Harmonic energy divided by percussive energy.

features.label: Timbre motion
features.explain: How quickly the timbre changes frame to frame.

features.label: Stereo width
features.explain: Side energy relative to mid energy across the whole track.

features.label: Level
features.explain: Average RMS level of the loudness-normalised window.

features.label: Dynamic range
features.explain: Spread between the loudest and quietest frames.

features.label: Punch (crest)
features.explain: Peak to RMS ratio. Low values mean heavy compression.

features.label: Loudness arc (30 s)
features.explain: Range of the smoothed loudness curve in the middle 30 s.

features.label: Harmonic motion
features.explain: How often the dominant pitch class changes.

features.label: Harmonic spread
features.explain: Entropy of the chroma vector; higher means denser harmony.
